lead: Cockroach Labs ships a Db2 migration built entirely by agents inside its coding hospital, byte-level Transformers challenge the tokenizer, and fake Claude installers ride Google ads through Bing redirects.

sections.title: The coding hospital
sections.intro: Cockroach Labs runs coding agents like a medical team, and a hobby OS wants agents at the kernel.

sections.title: Do models need tokenizers
sections.intro: Flat byte-level Transformers catch and pass subword models as they scale.

sections.title: Fake Claude installers
sections.intro: Malvertising abuses Bing redirects to push ClickFix attacks dressed as Claude.
